Study notes

Renders here are real. Both deployed collections on Ethereum Sepolia draw each card inside a 500,000,000-gas static call: BLOCKS_SINGLE_V1 returns its GIF, and BLOCKS_VIDEO_V3 returns a native SVG poster of frame 0, its lossless AVI and the self-contained player its animation_url embeds. The input is what mint() would store. The lab block is simulated, as in the V3 diversity audit: block 13,000,000 with a fixed timestamp, gas limit, base fee, beneficiary and chain ID. Only prevrandao changes, and it is the seed shown on each card.

Scene choice is computed in your browser with an exact port of SingleBlockData and Epoch.scene, verified byte-for-byte against the deployed contracts. V1 and V3 hash the same block under different version strings, so one seed lands in different scenes in each. Forced scene and rare studies search for seeds of that scene; they do not represent mint probabilities. V2 is a prepared, undeployed revision; its cards are first-frame posters from measured previews.
